situation: A family-owned maker of industrial pumps that has received an offer for the whole business.
complication: The offer is priced below what comparable industrial pump deals have fetched.
key_question: Is the offer fair against comparable deals, and what should the owners do before the buyer's deadline?

titles.situation: The owners have an offer for the business and a deadline.
titles.options: Three ways to respond to the buyer.
titles.roadmap: Counter within the buyer's deadline, then negotiate terms.
titles.kpis: Two measures show whether the deal closes on fair value.
titles.risks: The main risk is the buyer walking away.

options.name: Counter at the comparable multiple
options.description: Reply within the deadline asking for a price at the comparable multiple, backed by the deal list.

options.name: Accept the offer

options.description: Invite other buyers to bid before answering.
